description: Raises an error if its first argument is false/nil; otherwise returns all its arguments. Pure language op.

Raises an error with the given message object (any type) and unwinds. level is honored: a string message gets a chunk:line: prefix from the call site level frames up (level 0 = no prefix), via Vm.raiseLocatedError + the shared callSiteAt locator.
Calls a function in protected mode via Vm.callValue; returns true plus results, or false plus the error object. Catchable faults only (OOM/effect-log errors rethrow to protect determinism).
Like pcall but takes a message handler invoked with the error value after the unwind. Before-unwind traceback access waits on debug.traceback.
With a number n returns all arguments after the n-th; with '#' returns the count of extra arguments.
Returns the type of its argument as a string (nil/boolean/number/string/table/function/thread/userdata).
Converts any value to a string, honouring __tostring and __name metafields.
Converts its argument to a number (optionally in a given base), or returns nil/fail.
Returns (next, t, nil): a deterministic iterator over all key/value pairs (array part ascending, then hash part in canonical key order).
Returns an iterator over the array part of a table until the first nil.
Primitive table traversal: array part ascending then hash part in canonical key order; underpins pairs and is snapshot-stable.
Compares two values for equality without invoking __eq.
Reads table[index] without invoking __index.
Writes table[index]=value without invoking __newindex; returns the table.
Returns the length of a table or string without invoking __len.
Sets (or removes) the metatable of a table; errors if protected. Returns the table.
Returns the metatable of an object, or the __metatable field if protected.
Global environment table; mutating it changes the global namespace.
Global string with the running language/version; lune would set its own value.
Interface to the garbage collector. lune has its own GC, so the option set may differ from Lua's.
Compiles a chunk from a string/reader into a callable closure. Deterministic; runtime-compile is a design choice.
Writes arguments (via tostring) to stdout, tab-separated, trailing newline. lune: nativePrint, routed through Vm.out (injectable). The canonical pure-output effect.
Emits a warning from its string args; @on/@off toggle the system. Diagnostic output effect (5.4).
Loads and runs a file as a chunk (stdin with no arg). Needs filesystem; CLI-only.
Compiles a chunk from a file without running it. Needs filesystem; CLI-only.
Excluded by design: lune never exposes coroutines. Coroutine-like sequencing is built hidden on the lune backend; the public surface gets async primitives instead (a deliberate divergence from Lua).
Excluded by design: see coroutine.create. lune offers async primitives, not user-visible coroutines.

Returns the numeric byte codes of characters in s between positions i and j.
Builds a string from zero or more integer byte values.
Searches s for a pattern; returns start/end indices and captures, or nil. plain disables magic.
Returns a formatted string using printf-style directives plus Lua extensions (%q, %s, etc.).
Returns an iterator yielding successive pattern matches/captures over the string.
Returns a copy of s with up to n pattern occurrences replaced (string/number/table/function replacement, the last via Vm.callValue); also returns the count.
Returns the length of the string in bytes (same as #).
Returns a copy with uppercase letters lowercased (C locale).
Returns the captures (or whole match) of the first pattern occurrence in s, or nil.
Returns the string repeated n times, optionally joined by a separator.
Returns the string with its bytes reversed.
Returns the substring of s from i to j (negative indices count from the end).
Returns a copy with lowercase letters uppercased (C locale).
Serialises values into a binary string per a format string of size/endianness codes.
Returns the byte size of a fixed-size string.pack format.
Deserialises values from a binary string per a format; also returns the next position.
Emits a function's bytecode for reloading. lune has its own bytecode/IR; serialising it is determinism- and security-hostile.
Builds a UTF-8 string from zero or more Unicode code-point integers.
A pattern matching exactly one UTF-8 byte sequence (one code point).
Iterator yielding the byte position and code point of each character.
Returns the code points of characters in s between byte positions i and j.
Returns the number of UTF-8 characters in s[i..j], or nil plus the first invalid byte position.
Returns the byte position of the n-th character from position i (negative counts backwards).
Concatenates array elements list[i..j] into a string separated by sep.
Inserts value at position pos (default: end), shifting later elements up.
Removes and returns the element at pos (default: last), shifting later elements down.
Copies a1[f..e] into a2 starting at index t (handles overlapping ranges).
Returns a new table holding all args in its array part plus an 'n' count field.
Returns list[i..j] as multiple return values (inverse of table.pack).

Sorts the list in place using < or a comparator (called via Vm.callValue). Heapsort — deterministic, O(n log n) worst case, terminates under an inconsistent comparator; not stable and we do not emulate Lua's invalid-order-function detection.
Returns the absolute value of x, preserving integer/float subtype.
Returns the smallest integer not less than x.
Returns the largest integer not greater than x.
Returns the remainder of x/y rounding the quotient toward zero (C fmod).
Returns the integral and fractional parts of x as two values.
Returns the square root of x.
Returns e raised to the power x.
Returns the logarithm of x in the given base (default natural log).
Returns the sine of x (radians).
Returns the cosine of x (radians).
Returns the tangent of x (radians).
Returns the arc sine of x (radians).
Returns the arc cosine of x (radians).
Returns atan(y/x) using both signs to pick the quadrant (x defaults to 1).
Converts x from radians to degrees.
Converts x from degrees to radians.
Returns the maximum of its numeric arguments.
Returns the minimum of its numeric arguments.
Returns x as an integer if exactly representable, else nil/fail.
Returns 'integer'/'float'/nil for the number subtype of x.
Returns whether integer m < n when both are read as unsigned.
The constant pi.
Positive infinity (HUGE_VAL).
The maximum representable integer value.
The minimum representable integer value.
Pseudo-random integer in [m,n] or float in [0,1). lune exposes a flat 'random' global (nativeRandom); its seed is the recorded effect (.random_seed) for replay.
Seeds the PRNG (5.4 with no args seeds from an OS source). Seed is a nondeterministic input the effect log must capture.
CPU/wall time in seconds. lune exposes a flat 'clock' global (nativeClock) tagged EffectKind.clock (log-outputs), routed through the injected ClockSource.
Current time as a numeric timestamp, or the time encoded by a date table. Nondeterministic input; log-outputs effect.
Formatted date/time string or table of components for a given time. Time input is an effect; formatting is pure.
Returns t2 - t1 in seconds. Pure arithmetic over timestamps; no host call.
Returns the value of an environment variable, or nil. Nondeterministic input; log-outputs effect.
Terminates the program with a code/boolean, optionally closing state. CLI lifecycle concern.
Deletes a file or empty directory. Filesystem mutation; CLI-only.
Renames a file or directory. Filesystem mutation; CLI-only.
Returns a name usable for a temporary file. Filesystem; CLI-only.
Runs a command via the OS shell. Process spawning: nondeterministic and unsandboxable; forbidden.
Sets/queries the C locale per category. Mutable global locale breaks reproducibility; lune fixes locale semantics.
Opens a file in a mode, returning a handle (or nil plus error). Filesystem; CLI-only.
Closes a file (default: current output file).
Reads from the current input file per the given formats. Input effect; CLI-only.
Writes string/number args to the current output file; returns the file.
Iterator reading successive lines/reads from a file, closing it at the end.
Sets or returns the current default input file.
Sets or returns the current default output file.
Flushes buffered output of the current output file.
Returns a handle to an auto-removed temporary file. Filesystem; CLI-only.
Returns 'file'/'closed file'/nil for a candidate handle.
Predefined handle for standard input.
Predefined handle for standard output.
Predefined handle for standard error.
Runs a program in a separate process, connected by a pipe. Process spawning; forbidden like os.execute.
Method: reads from the file using the given formats.
Method: writes its arguments to the file; returns the file.
Method: returns a line iterator over the file.
Method: gets/sets the file position relative to set/cur/end.
Method: flushes the file's buffered output.
Method: sets buffering mode (no/full/line) and optional size.
Method: closes the file handle.
Loads a module by name via searchers, running it once and caching the result. Needs filesystem; CLI-only.
Table of already-loaded modules keyed by name; require consults and populates it.
Table of loader functions tried before the path searchers.
Search-path template for Lua module source files.
Search-path template for native module libraries.
String describing path-handling configuration (separators, marks).
Ordered list of searcher functions require tries.
Searches a path template for a module name; returns the found name or nil plus tried paths.
Dynamically links a C library and returns a function from it. No sandbox/determinism guarantee; forbidden.
Returns a string traceback of the call stack, optionally prefixed by a message. Useful diagnostic over VM state.
Returns info about a function or stack level. Reflection superseded by the trace visualiser; breaks abstraction.
Returns the name/value of a local at a stack level. Reflection; use the trace visualiser instead.
Assigns a local at a stack level. Mutating reflection; breaks the deterministic model.
Returns the name/value of a function upvalue. Reflection; superseded by the visualiser.
Sets a function upvalue. Mutating reflection; forbidden.
Returns a unique id for an upvalue cell. Implementation-internal reflection.
Makes one closure's upvalue share another's cell. Implementation-internal mutation.
Returns a value's metatable ignoring __metatable protection. Use the basic getmetatable.
Sets the metatable of any-typed value. Bypasses protection; use the basic setmetatable.
Returns the implementation's internal registry table. Implementation-internal.
Returns a userdata's n-th user value. C-userdata reflection; out of scope.
Sets a userdata's n-th user value. C-userdata reflection; out of scope.
Returns the current debug hook. Hook machinery superseded by the trace recorder.
Installs a per-call/return/line/count hook. Conflicts with the JIT and trace recorder; forbidden.
Enters an interactive debug REPL. Superseded by the time-travel visualiser.
